def paperParameters (P m lam : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hlam' : lam < 1 / 10) : Parameters where
  P := P
  m := m
  lam := lam
  wait := 60 * Real.log (1 / lam)
  P_pos := hP
  m_pos := hm
  lam_pos := hlam
  lam_lt := hlam'
  wait_gt := by
    have h := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (one_div_pos.mpr hlam)
    simp only [one_div, inv_inv] at h ⊢
    nlinarith
